name: latex-render
description: Renders LaTeX math in Claude's replies: display math as real LaTeX images (kitty/Ghostty/iTerm2), inline math as Unicode.

scale.title: Math scale
scale.description: Size of rendered display math relative to the terminal font

color.title: Math color
color.description: Hex color for rendered math, e.g. #e6e6e6; empty follows the theme

python.title: Python
python.description: Python 3 executable that runs the renderer
